name: Nikolaus von Taysen
headline: Impact | FinTech
summary:
I am a serial entrepreneur who co-founded or initiated for-profit as well as non-profit ventures. Most of my experiences come from Impact (Bonum) and FinTech (Finparx) projects.

Please note: I neither act as a Business Angel nor as a VC for external ventures. Please read my netiquette at https://bonum.eu/contact before contacting me.
